heading: INT. OPERA HOUSE - FLY GALLERY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. OPERA HOUSE - FLY GALLERY - NIGHT
Catwalks and ropes in the dark above the stage.
Below, far down, a soprano rehearses a long note, and the sound rises through the grating.
Canvas drops hang like sails.
Three figures work their way along a narrow gantry.
The first, a woman in a stagehand's black, carries a coil of rope across her shoulder and does not look down.
The second, a short man in a tuxedo with his collar undone, grips the rail with both hands, his knuckles pale, and mouths a count of the steps.
The third, a lean figure in a hooded sweatshirt, walks backward along the plank, scanning the dark behind them.
The woman is DELPHINE ARCHAMBAULT, 40s.
The short man is MONTGOMERY "MONTY" PRYCE, 50s.
The hooded figure is JIN-HO BAEK, 20s.
Chandelier winch is on the left.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: I can't do heights.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Left or my left?
units.name: ^JIN-HO

units.text: Delphine stops.
She lays the rope on the plank, takes Monty's hand off the rail, and places it on her shoulder.
He grips.
She walks on, with the little man shuffling behind her and the hooded boy turning to follow, still facing backward.
Below, the soprano finishes.
Applause, scattered.
A voice calls "Take ten."
The lights on the stage flicker down.
The three on the gantry freeze, then move again, faster.
Where's the box?
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Under the winch.
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: It's not under it. It's inside it.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: They reach the winch, a squat iron drum with a hand crank.
Delphine kneels, runs her fingers along its housing, and finds a latch.
It clicks.
A panel swings open.
Inside, wrapped in velvet, a jeweled mask the size of a dinner plate gleams in the dark.
Monty exhales.
Jin-ho whistles softly.
Delphine lifts the mask, turns it over, and holds it up to the glow of the stage light below.
It's smaller than I thought.
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: It's bigger than I feared.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: It's exactly right.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: A footstep, distant, rings on iron.
A flashlight beam swings along the far end of the gantry.
All three duck.
Monty presses himself to the plank.
Jin-ho slides the panel shut with one finger.
Delphine tucks the mask inside her jacket and unspools the rope.
The flashlight comes nearer and stops, a long way below the gantry, searching.
Delphine looks at Monty.
Monty looks at Jin-ho.
Jin-ho shrugs and cups his hands.
Just rigging, boss!
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: The beam lingers, then turns away.
Footsteps recede.
Monty lets out a laugh that is half sob.
Don't fall. He said don't fall.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Good advice.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: She ties the rope to a rail, tosses the free end into the dark, and swings a leg over the edge.
